title: messaging.py: Message ID counter never incremented
description: Line 137 reads `self._next_id` into local `candidate_next_id`, which is then incremented (line 142) or updated (line 144), but the result is never assigned back to `self._next_id`. Every auto-assigned message gets ID 1, overwriting previous messages in `_sent` dict. Missing line after 144: `self._next_id = candidate_next_id`
close_reason: Dup of worker6-hppr/gefg. Root cause: render_post incremented candidate_next_id but never wrote it back to self._next_id, so every auto-assigned POST reused ID 1 and overwrote the prior sent message. Fixed once in python/src/lichen/coap/resources/messaging.py:159 (self._next_id = candidate_next_id, persisted across requests for process lifetime; no await or early return between read and write, so atomic under the asyncio event loop; module spawns no threads). Verified by tests/coap/test_messages_resource.py (_next_id==2 after one auto POST; u64 saturation persists) and full messaging suite: 119 passed.
